notes.title: Update 1.03 — Latin Spanish & Brazilian Portuguese Now Available!
notes.content:
Today’s update is especially close to our hearts — Carnal Contract now includes Latin American Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese! 



We know how passionate the gaming community is across Latin America and Brazil, and how much you’ve been asking for this. It was really important to us that you can fully experience the story in your own language, and we’re thrilled to finally deliver it.



From now on, you can switch to Spanish or Portuguese directly in the settings menu and enjoy Carnal Contract the way it was meant to be played.



Keep in mind, both Latin American Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese will go through one more proofreading round this week, so if you notice any mistakes, they will be fixed in the coming days.



But we’re not stopping here. The next language will be Russian, which we expect to release in the first week of October. After that, in October, we’ll announce which other language we’ll begin working on next. Step by step, we want Carnal Contract to feel welcoming and accessible to players all around the world.



Thank you so much for supporting us, for spreading the word, and for being part of this community. Every message we get from you motivates us to keep improving, and making Carnal Contract better with every update.



— Dotty Diaries

notes.content:
Hi everyone,



We’ve just released a new update that adds 18 new achievements to the game, along with a round of bug fixes and small improvements.



Thank you to everyone who reported issues and shared feedback.



Update 1.01 patch notes

New Content

Added 18 new achievements.

Minor changes / Bugfixes

Fixed missing audio file crash.

Fixed wrong character attribution.

Fixed incorrect render in a flashback scene.

Fixed minor grammatical errors.



Thanks again for your support, reviews, and feedback. They mean a lot and help the game reach more players. We’ll keep working on polishing the experience and preparing for future updates.



Until next time,
Dotty

notes.title: Carnal Contract - Engaging Visual Novel
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2484170/Carnal_Contract/


Carnal Contract - Short Description

Carnal Contract is an adult Visual Novel in which you take control of a young man who got stuck in major debts. A strange game provides a way out, but only if he dares to complete carnal challenges. The game is filled with sex, mystery, different challenges and drama.

https://i.ibb.co/fvJsv44/e8i1157.webp

What Awaits You?

- Over 8,500 images.
- 250+ animated scenes.
- 5-10 hours gameplay.
- Diverse adult content.
- Gorgeous character interactions.
- Mysterious story.

https://i.ibb.co/y0GNC5R/e5i413.webp


When the Game Will be Available?

We have created over 8500 images, both designed and rendered. Currently, we're adding additional scenes to fill gaps in the story.

Initially, the plan was to release the game after completing 8500 renders, but over 10.000 people played it during the development phase and provided feedback that I couldn't ignore.

Now, we're planning to create an additional 1500-2000 renders before launching on STEAM to complete the story.

For the last 16 months, I have been working on this game full-time, dedicating all my effort to ensure it's an amazing experience for everyone who plays it.

It's not just about the graphics; it's about the experience and the feelings you get while playing.

I'll post updates here every few weeks to keep you informed and excited about Carnal Contract.

https://i.ibb.co/nwHMgSW/e3i216-f-6.webp

Thank You!

If you find yourself enjoying the work I've put into creating this game and wish to express your support, kindly consider adding it to your wishlist.

I extend my deepest gratitude for taking the time to visit my page and for your generous appreciation.

Warm regards,

Dotty
